summary: Phase 3 (Support Ticketing) + landing-page UI polish — 22/22 pytest passed and all UI assertions confirmed against live preview URL. Backend covers categories, label-create (success + 5 category-specific validations + cross-label 403), list/detail/visibility, comment status flips (admin→waiting_label, label→waiting_admin), admin status update (creates system comment), label cancel (allowed on open, 400 on done), closed-ticket comment block (400 'ditutup'), and attachment upload validation (audio=wav only, cover=3000x3000 only, general=jpg/png/pdf/wav/mp3/txt/docx). Frontend smoke: landing page no longer has '60% default bagian label', hero shows the three new stats, pricing footer reads only 'Fee distributor: 5%', the new Platforms section with image testid 'landing-platforms-image' (3000x518 PNG) renders correctly, and the Emergent badge is in DOM but display:none. Label side /label/support shows 3 seeded tickets (TEST_TD Sedang Diproses, TEST_OTHER cancel me Dibatalkan, TEST_OTHER will close Selesai), +Tiket Baru opens modal with 8-category select and own-releases dropdown. Admin side /admin/tickets shows the list with status+category filters and ticket detail page exposes 'admin-ticket-set-status-button'. /admin/royalty Upload CSV button (admin-royalty-upload-button) present.

minor.issue: Status flip skips 'submitted_to_believe' — when ticket is at submitted_to_believe, a label/admin comment does NOT change status. Likely intentional (waiting on Believe externally), but neither does it advance to waiting_admin. Consider documenting this in PRD.
MIME type is not validated, only file extension. A user could upload an .exe renamed to .pdf and pass. Add python-magic or mimetypes.guess_type cross-check for production.
Subject/description trimmed only by Pydantic min_length=3 — whitespace-only strings of >=3 chars pass (e.g., '   '). Consider .strip() validator.

integration_issues.flow: Auth transition label1 logout -> super_admin login
integration_issues.issue: Two 401 console errors during cookie clear + redirect — same noise observed in iteration_2. Non-blocking.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by Emergent dev-mode instrumentation injecting tracking <span> tags inside <option> elements of the release dropdown. Harmless at runtime but pollutes the console. Will disappear in production build.

action_items: Cross-check MIME type in /api/tickets/upload-attachment to prevent extension spoofing (low priority).
Decide and document whether comments on 'submitted_to_believe' tickets should be allowed and what status they flip to.
Phase-1 leftovers still pending: brute-force lockout via X-Forwarded-For and removing verification_token/reset_token from prod auth responses.
critical_code_review_comments: ticket_r.post('/upload-attachment') reads the FULL cover file into memory before image-size validation (.read() into BytesIO) — fine for 5MB JPEGs but flag if covers grow. Audio/general path uses streaming copyfileobj which is correct.

label_create_ticket inserts ticket then immediately inserts a description comment without a transaction; if comment insert fails the ticket exists without first message. For MVP acceptable; consider single batch insert or Mongo session.
_ticket_visible_to does an extra db.labels.find_one per request — could be cached on the user object (label_id) at login to save one round-trip per ticket view.

TICKET_NON_CANCELLABLE includes 'cancelled' so cancel-again returns 400 (correct), but error message 'Hubungi admin' on already-cancelled tickets is slightly misleading — consider distinguishing 'already cancelled' vs 'cannot cancel (final state)'.
Admin status endpoint does not validate transitions (e.g., one can jump from 'open' directly to 'done' without going through 'in_progress'). For MVP fine, but document allowed transitions in PRD.

rca_of_the_issue: No product bugs found in this iteration. Two UI selectors initially appeared 'missing' (support-comment-submit and admin-ticket-comment-submit) — RCA: the test clicked the first ticket detail link in the list, which happened to be a cancelled ticket (B36D5). Comment form is correctly hidden on closed tickets (backend also returns 400 'Tiket sudah ditutup' for comment attempts in this state). This is correct UX, not a bug. Verified by reading server.py:2114 (status block) and observing 'Tiket sudah ditutup. Tidak bisa menambah komentar.' message in the UI.
